title: First Northern Community Bancorp Reports Third Quarter 2026 Net Income of $6.2 Million
summary: DIXON, Calif., October 29, 2026--First Northern Community Bancorp (the "Company", NASDAQ: FNRN), holding company for First Northern Bank ("First Northern" or the "Bank"), today reported net income of $16.8 million, or $1.02 per diluted share, for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, up 11.1% compared to net income of $15.2 million, or $0.91 per diluted share, for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.

title: First Northern Community Bancorp Reports Second Quarter 2026 Net Income of $4.7 Million
summary: DIXON, Calif., July 30, 2026--First Northern Community Bancorp (the "Company", NASDAQ: FNRN), holding company for First Northern Bank ("First Northern" or the "Bank"), today reported net income of $10.6 million, or $0.64 per diluted share, for the six months ended June 30, 2026, up 16.4% compared to net income of $9.1 million, or $0.55 per diluted share, for the six months ended June 30, 2025.
